correctness.rationale: For each n≥5 the closed neighborhoods are distinct-site cyclic five-windows. Summing their occupancies proves 5k≤3n; each admissible word contributes its summed deficit 3n−5k to the indexed closed-walk trace with no rotation quotient. Independently computed det(I−tM) by the disjoint directed cycle expansion: 44 simple cycles in the four-bit transition graph; each compatible collection contributes (−1)^(number of cycles) t^(total length) u^(total deficit). The surviving coefficients are exactly 1, −tu³, −t²u, −t⁴u², −2t⁵, +t⁷u, +t¹⁰. The formal trace identity gives N=−t∂_tD. With z=t⁵, expand −log D through u⁴ after pulling out (1−z)². For r=0 the t-derivative gives the positive multiples-of-five coefficient 10; for r=1,2,3,4 the respective A_n/n are (q+1)+(4/3)binom(q+1,2), 1, binom(q+2,2)+(7/4)binom(q+2,3), and (3/2)(q+1). These simplify to the printed formulas and show the floor bound is attained. Direct independent bit-window census matches all recorded cardinalities for n=5,…,18. The stored programs and outputs were read, not executed; the degree-bounded grid certificate is also valid in principle but the independent determinant calculation does not rely on it.
residual_risks: Applies only to indexed subsets in the simple square of C_n with n≥5 and the specified closed-neighborhood bound.
